summary: Iter 25 — Verified BankEzee Connect production repair (Leave 2-days/month, Monthly Attendance Summary, My Hourly Report, Distinct call outcomes, Stats filter consistency, Never-Called consistency, Switched-Off filter). All 13 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend Leave Management page renders perfectly at /admin/leave with year selector (2024-2027), all 4 required cards (Leave Accrued=18, Leave Used=0, Leave Available=18, Full Year Allowance=24) showing correct 2-days/month accrual for September 2026 (9 months × 2 = 18). CRITICAL BLOCKER: Files Dashboard (/admin/files, /agent/files) is completely broken — throws ReferenceError: reportData is not defined and shows Uncaught runtime error overlay. Component never mounts, so Approvals tab visibility for GP cannot be verified.

minor.issue: by_outcome.never_called is derived from last_call_outcome being null while totals.never_called uses last_call_at existence — two different semantics under the same name. Currently consistent because both are null on freshly-imported leads, but could drift when a lead has last_call_at set but last_call_outcome null.

For future years (e.g. year=2027) accrued still returns 0 which is correct, but for the SPECIFIC scenario in the test spec (year=2026 should show accrued=18 for September), the endpoint returns accrued = current_IST_month * 2. In Jan 2026 accrued=2, not 18. The 'accrued=18 for September' assumption in the request only holds when server clock is in September; in the live env (currently 02-Sep-2026 IST) it correctly returns 18 as verified in UI. Backend logic is correct — just noting the spec's month-dependency.
Line 183 calls ObjectId(user_id) unconditionally — will 500 on UUID user ids (same defensive-cast anti-pattern flagged in iter24 for /api/leads/{id}).
(carried from iter 23) Still no auth guard on report endpoints — anonymous callers can fetch daily/rejected/quality/growth-partner/bank-performance/tat-metrics.

rca of the issue: Bug: FilesDashboard component throws ReferenceError: reportData is not defined on mount. Reproduction: 1) Login as admin@bankezee.com/ConnectSasha12!! 2) Navigate to /admin/files → immediate Uncaught runtime error overlay. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/pages/files/FilesDashboard.js references `reportData?.monthly_stats` (line 1013), `reportData.monthly_stats.map` (1015), `reportData?.loan_type_stats` (1034), `reportData.loan_type_stats.map` (1036), and `reportData.loan_type_stats[0]?.count` (1046). No `reportData` variable is declared anywhere in the component. The actual declared state is `reports` (line 62, setter line 219). This is a leftover from the mock-data removal refactor where a state rename didn't propagate. Mitigation: search-replace `reportData` → `reports` across the file (5 sites, all in the Reports panel). If backend `/files/reports` response doesn't yet expose `monthly_stats`/`loan_type_stats`, wrap in nullish checks so the empty-state UI ('No monthly data available' / 'No loan type data available') renders instead of crashing. Impact of NOT fixing: /admin/files and /agent/files are 100% broken — no files browsable, no reports viewable, no approvals workflow — a P0 production regression.
